title: 第19章 抢工作又名争宠第20章 云擎 示弱引蛇
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
这种沉默，比直接的质问更让云擎心悸。云煌的洞察力太过敏锐，自己这番表演，或许能瞒过一时，但未必能永远瞒天过海。此刻他不追究，更像是一种暂不点破的观望与审视。
这柄悬在头顶的利剑，不知何时会落下。
云擎深知，他窥见的那些关于仙帝转世的深层隐秘，如同潜藏于暗流深海中的巨兽。一旦云煌察觉他已窥见冰山全貌，必将引发毁灭性的风暴。
“你前世之界，又是何等光景？”云煌没回答云擎的问题，反而轻描淡写地将问题抛了回来。
看似随意闲谈，但云煌可以无视他的问题，他却不能不答。
云擎心底无奈一叹，二长老说的没错，果真是活祖宗。
他沉吟片刻，语调带着几分释然与追忆，缓缓道：“前世……人生天地之间，若白驹之过隙，忽然而已。擎前世不过是碌碌众生中一介凡人，寿不过百，每日为生计奔波，所见天地，不过方寸之地，所历世事，无非柴米油盐。比之此界大道无垠，修士飞天遁地，实乃云泥之别，不堪相比。”
云煌静静听着，面上无波无澜，唯有那双金瞳，仿佛能穿透皮囊直视云擎灵魂深处。片刻后，他才淡淡道：“机缘如此，当好生把握。”
“擎谨记。”云擎垂首，姿态恭顺。
镇魂碑修复完毕，光华内蕴，更胜往昔。云煌凝视片刻，并未再多言，转身道：“回殿。”
“是。”
两道玄色身影一前一后踏入栖梧主殿，殿内明珠清辉流转，映照得空旷的大殿愈发肃穆威仪。甫一进入，云擎便察觉到殿内多了一道气息。
只见一名身着云骁卫玄甲、身形与他有六七分相似，面容却更显阴柔俊美的青年，正垂首恭立于殿柱的阴影之下，如同蛰伏的毒蛇。
正是十二长老的嫡孙，云魑。
云擎眼底掠过一丝微不可察的讶异。此人竟能进入云骁卫，还被安排到栖梧殿当值？十二长老的手，伸得比他预想的还要长。
见到云煌归来，云魑立刻上前一步，单膝跪地，动作标准利落：“云魑拜见少君。奉家族调令，今日起入职云骁卫，特来向少君报到，听候差遣。”他言语清晰，姿态恭谨，隐隐有几分云擎平日的姿态。
云煌脚步未停，仿佛没看见他一般，径直走向主位，只淡淡“嗯”了一声，算是回应。
云擎步履从容地走过，不着痕迹地侧身半步，避开了云魑的跪礼范围，只对他微微颔首，算是同族之间的礼节，随即在云煌玉座侧前方那熟悉的位置停下，微微垂首，姿态恭谨而自然。
云魑眼角几不可察地抽搐了一下，迅速压下心头翻涌的嫉恨，调整好表情。他双手恭敬地奉上一枚流光溢彩的玉简，声音愈发谦卑：“少君，奉统领之命，呈送本季度云氏各域巡防纪要，请您过目。”
云煌并未抬眼，只随意地抬了抬手，示意他呈上来。

云魑心下一定，趋步上前，躬身将玉简小心翼翼呈到云煌手边。待云煌接过，他却并未如寻常侍卫般退至殿下，而是脚步微动，如同云擎一般，自然地站到了云煌玉座另一侧的下首位置。
一时间，玄玉座前，云擎与云魑，一左一右，恰形成左右对峙之势。
云煌目光在他身上停留一瞬，便垂眸看着手中玉简，未置可否。既未表露满意，也未出言斥退，仿佛默认了这种微妙格局。
云魑垂眸敛目，心下却是狂喜！祖父果然神机妙算，上位者需要的从来不是独一无二，而是可供选择与制衡的工具！只要他能展现出足够的价值，取代云擎，他便是下一位云氏天骄！
栖梧殿内陷入一片静谧，唯有云煌翻阅玉简的细微声响，以及明珠光华流淌的声音。
无人开口说话，云魑也低眉顺眼，试图将自己也融入这殿内侍立的背景中。
眼角余光扫过对面垂眸静立的云擎，只见这位大公子眼观鼻，鼻观心，长睫低垂，掩去了重瞳的幽深，整个人气息平和内敛，姿态是前所未有的温顺乖巧，与昨日在宗祠外那般锋芒毕露、一招定鼎乾坤的凌厉形象判若两人。
‘这云擎在少君面前竟装得这一副温良恭俭让的模样！连这等天骄都需如此伏低做小……怪不得祖父那般忌惮，看来少君的身份与实力，远比外界传闻的更为恐怖。’’他心中念头急转，对云煌有了更深的猜测与忌惮。
在这令人窒息的静谧中呆了约莫一炷香的时间，云魑只觉得浑身不自在，那无形的压力几乎要将他压垮。他深吸一口气，刚想寻个由头开口，彰显一下自己的存在感，也好打破这对他不利的沉寂。
就在他嘴唇微动的刹那——
对面的云擎动了。
他没有看云魑，只是上前半步，极其自然熟稔地执起云煌案几上那只微凉的灵玉茶盏。指尖一缕温和的混沌之气微吐，杯中之茶瞬间升腾起袅袅白雾，温度被精准控制在最适宜入口的刹那。他轻轻将茶杯放回云煌手边最容易取用的位置，整个过程行云流水，带着一种难以言喻的亲昵与默契。
“少君，晨露寒重，饮些热茶暖暖身。”他声音温和低沉，带着恰到好处的关切，每一个细节都彰显着对主人习惯的精准把握。
云煌执笔批阅的手微微一顿，抬眸，淡金色的眼瞳瞥了云擎一眼，那目光深邃难明，看不出是赞许还是其他，但他并未阻止，反而顺手端起了那杯温度刚好的茶，浅啜一口。
云擎这才仿佛刚注意到云魑的存在般，侧过头，唇角勾起一抹看似温和实则疏离的弧度：“云魑堂弟当值辛苦，可要也来一杯？想来少君仁厚，不至于吝啬殿中一杯灵茶。”
他这是什么意思？！不过是戴罪随侍，真把自己当成栖梧殿的主人了不成？！云魑胸中怒火翻腾，面上却强挤出一丝僵硬的笑容，试图维持风度，并暗踩云擎一脚：“多谢大公子美意。只是这茶乃是少君专用之物，灵气非凡，魑身份低微，岂敢妄饮……”
云煌依旧垂眸看着手中的玉简，仿佛对两人之间这无声的的交锋毫无所觉。但若细看，便能发现他唇角几不可察地弯了一下，转瞬即逝。

content_en:
This kind of silence made Yun Qing's heart palpitate more than the direct questioning. Yunhuang's insight is too keen. His performance may be able to hide it for a while, but it may not be able to hide it forever. At the moment, he doesn't pursue it, it's more like watching and examining without commenting.
This sharp sword hanging above my head does not know when it will fall.
Yun Qing knew very well that the deep secrets about the reincarnation of the Immortal Emperor that he had glimpsed were like giant beasts lurking in the undercurrents of the deep sea. Once Yunhuang realizes that he has seen the entire iceberg, a devastating storm will surely occur.
"What was the situation like in your previous life?" Yunhuang did not answer Yun Qing's question, but instead threw the question back in an understatement.
It seemed like a casual chat, but Yunhuang could ignore his questions, but he had to answer them.
Yun Qing sighed helplessly in his heart, the second elder was right, he was indeed a living ancestor.
He pondered for a moment, with a tone of relief and reminiscence, and said slowly: "In the past life... in life, there was a gap between heaven and earth, just like a white horse passing by, all of a sudden. In the previous life, Qing was just a mortal among all living beings. He lived less than a hundred years, running around for a living every day. He saw no more than an inch of the world, and experienced nothing more than firewood, rice, oil and salt. Compared with this world, the avenues are boundless, and the monks flying to the sky and escaping to the earth are really different from clouds and mud, and are incomparable."
Yun Huang listened quietly, his face calm, except for his golden eyes, which seemed to be able to penetrate the skin and look directly into the depths of Yun Qing's soul. After a moment, he said calmly: "The opportunity is like this, so you should seize it."
"Qing, please remember." Yun Qing lowered his head in a respectful manner.
The restoration of the Soul-Calling Monument has been completed, and its brilliance is even greater than before. Yunhuang stared for a moment, said nothing more, turned around and said: "Go back to the palace."
"Yes."
Two black figures stepped into the main hall of Qiwu one after another. The bright pearls in the hall were flowing, making the empty hall become more solemn and majestic. As soon as he entered, Yun Qing noticed an extra breath in the hall.
I saw a young man wearing Yun Xiaowei Xuanjia, whose body shape was sixty-seven minutes similar to him, but whose face was more feminine and handsome. He was standing in the shadow of the palace pillar with his head bowed, like a dormant poisonous snake.
He is the direct grandson of the Twelve Elders, Yun Chi.
There was a trace of imperceptible surprise in Yun Qing's eyes. This person could actually enter Yunxiao Guard and be assigned to be on duty in Qiwu Palace? The twelfth elder's hand stretched out longer than he expected.
Seeing Yun Huang's return, Yun Chi immediately stepped forward, knelt down on one knee, and said neatly: "Yun Chi pays homage to Shaojun. By order of the family, he will join the Yunxiao Guards starting today. He is here to report to Shaojun and be ready for dispatch." His words were clear and his posture was respectful, a bit like Yun Qing's usual posture.
Yunhuang didn't stop, as if he hadn't seen him, and walked straight to the main seat. He only responded with a faint "hmm".
Yun Qing walked calmly past, taking half a step sideways without leaving a trace, avoiding Yun Chi's kneeling range. He only nodded slightly to him, which was considered a courtesy among the same clan, and then stopped at the familiar position in front of Yunhuang's throne, bowing his head slightly, with a respectful and natural posture.
The corners of Yun Chi's eyes twitched almost imperceptibly, and he quickly suppressed the resentment surging in his heart and adjusted his expression. He respectfully presented a gleaming jade slip with both hands, and his voice became more humble: "Young Master, by order of the commander, I am submitting the Yun Sect's patrol minutes in various areas for this quarter. Please take a look."
Yun Huang didn't raise his eyes, but raised his hand casually, motioning for him to present it.
Yun Chi was determined, stepped forward, bowed and carefully presented the jade slip to Yun Huang's hand. When Yunhuang took it, he did not retreat to His Highness like an ordinary guard. Instead, he moved slightly, like Yunqing, and naturally stood at the lower position on the other side of Yunhuang's jade throne.
For a moment, in front of the Xuanyu Seat, Yun Qing and Yun Chi stood on the left and right, forming a confrontation between the left and right.
Yunhuang's eyes stayed on him for a moment, then he lowered his eyes and looked at the jade slip in his hand, without commenting. He neither expressed satisfaction nor reprimanded him, as if he acquiesced to this subtle pattern.
Yun Chi lowered his eyes,My heart is filled with joy! As expected, my grandfather had a brilliant plan. What a superior person needs is never uniqueness, but tools for selection and checks and balances! As long as he can show enough value to replace Yun Qing, he will be the next Yun's genius!
The Qiwu Hall fell into silence, with only the faint sound of Yunhuang flipping through the jade slips and the sound of the brilliance of the pearl flowing.
No one spoke, Yun Chi also lowered his eyebrows and tried to blend himself into the background of the servants standing in the hall.
The corner of his eye swept across Yun Qing, who was standing quietly with his eyes lowered. He saw that the eldest son was looking at his nose and his nose, his long eyelashes were drooping, covering up the depth of his double pupils. His whole person's aura was calm and reserved, and his posture was unprecedentedly docile and docile. He was completely different from the fierce image outside the ancestral hall yesterday where he showed his sharp edge and could decide the world with one move.
‘This Yun Qing actually pretends to be gentle, courteous and thrifty in front of the young master! Even such a talented person has to be so humble... No wonder my grandfather is so afraid. It seems that Shaojun's identity and strength are far more terrifying than what the outside world has rumored. ’’ The thoughts in his mind turned rapidly, and he had deeper suspicions and fears about Yunhuang.
After staying in this suffocating silence for about a stick of incense, Yunji felt uncomfortable all over, and the invisible pressure almost crushed him. He took a deep breath, and was about to find a way to speak, to show his presence, and to break the silence that was not good for him.
The moment his lips moved slightly——
Yun Qing on the opposite side moved.
He didn't look at Yun Qi, he just took half a step forward and picked up the slightly cool jade tea cup on Yun Huang's desk with a very natural and familiar manner. A wisp of gentle chaotic air was exhaled from the fingertips, and a white mist instantly rose from the tea in the cup, and the temperature was precisely controlled at the most suitable moment for entry. He gently placed the tea cup back in Yunhuang's hand where it was most easily accessible. The whole process was smooth and smooth, with an indescribable intimacy and tacit understanding.
"Young Master, the morning dew is cold and heavy. Drink some hot tea to warm yourself up." His voice was gentle and low, with just the right amount of concern. Every detail showed his precise grasp of the master's habits.
Yunhuang's hand that was holding the review paused slightly, then he raised his eyes and glanced at Yun Qing with his pale golden eyes. The look was deep and hard to tell, and it was hard to tell whether it was approval or something else. However, he did not stop him. Instead, he picked up the cup of tea that was just the right temperature and took a sip.
Yun Qing seemed to have just noticed Yun Qing's existence. He turned his head and raised the corners of his lips in a curve that seemed gentle but actually distant: "Cousin Yun Qing is working hard on duty, but would you like a cup? I hope that the young gentleman is kind enough not to be stingy with a cup of spiritual tea in the palace."
What does he mean? ! He is just a servant of Dai Zui, does he really regard himself as the master of Qiwu Palace? ! Anger surged in Yun Qing's chest, but he forced a stiff smile on his face, trying to maintain his demeanor, and stepped on Yun Qing secretly: "Thank you, eldest son, for your kindness. However, this tea is only for Young Master. It has extraordinary aura, and Xiao's status is low, so how dare you drink it..."
Yunhuang still lowered his eyes and looked at the jade slip in his hand, as if he was completely unaware of the silent confrontation between the two. But if you look closely, you can see that the corners of his lips curved almost imperceptibly, and it disappeared briefly.
